name: mwc-advocates-pern
description: PERN Stack application for MWC Advocates law firm

scripts.mailhog:start: sudo docker run -d --name mwc-mailhog -p 1025:1025 -p 8025:8025 mailhog/mailhog:latest 2>/dev/null || echo 'MailHog already running'
scripts.mailhog:stop: sudo docker stop mwc-mailhog && sudo docker rm mwc-mailhog 2>/dev/null || echo 'MailHog not running'
scripts.mailhog:ui: echo '🔍 MailHog UI: http://localhost:8025' && open http://localhost:8025 2>/dev/null || xdg-open http://localhost:8025 2>/dev/null || echo 'Open http://localhost:8025 in your browser'
scripts.build: npm run server:build && npm run client:build
scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.clean: rm -rf server/dist client/dist server/node_modules client/node_modules node_modules

author: MWC Advocates Development Team
